overview: Phase walks the player through solid blocks with six selectable modes. The collision layer is client-side: onBlockBB replaces any intersecting block's bounding box with an inverted box, onUpdate sets noClip and zeroes motionY while the player stands inside a block, and onPushOut cancels the push-out of blocks. The movement layer is per-mode: teleport sequences of C04 position packets (Vanilla, Spartan, Skip), a no-packet setPosition jump (Clip, AAC3.5.0) with a sub-pixel C03 tweak, and a MoveEvent-driven lateral snap for Mineplex. Every packet mode sends onGround true throughout.

sections.p: BlockBBEvent is the client-side gate: when collideBlockIntersects reports the player's bounding box inside non-air and the block's box top sits above the player's feet, the handler rebuilds the box as new AxisAlignedBB(maxX, minY, maxZ, minX, minY, minZ), swapping the x and z extremes so the box carries inverted extents and the vanilla collide tests fail. onUpdate additionally sets noClip = true, motionY = 0 and onGround = true while inside a block (all modes except Mineplex), so gravity and the collide step both stop. onPushOut cancels the vanilla push-out of blocks, keeping the player planted inside the wall.

Vanilla mode is gated on onGround, a TickTimer of 2 ticks, horizontal collision, and not being inside a block unless sneaking. It queues six C04PacketPlayerPosition packets all with onGround true: the current position, (0.5, 0, 0.5), the position again, the position with y + 0.2, (0.5, 0, 0.5) again, and the position offset by (0.5, 0, 0.5), then nudges the local position 0.04 blocks along the yaw. Spartan mode mirrors it with y - 0.2 instead of +0.2. Skip mode runs three iterations of a y + 0.06 packet followed by a stepped x/z packet, then offsets the bounding box and calls setPositionAndUpdate 0.3 blocks along the movement direction.

Clip and AAC3.5.0 send nothing: Clip scans up to 10 blocks along the yaw for a spot where the feet and feet+1 positions are both air and setPosition there, AAC3.5.0 teleports exactly 1 block along the yaw and additionally rewrites every outgoing C03's x and z by plus or minus 1.0E-8 along the movement direction, a sub-0.03 tweak the server ignores for position but applies to the onGround flag. Mineplex runs from MoveEvent: horizontal collision arms a 3-tick clip, the event x/z are zeroed each tick, tick 2 snaps 0.06 blocks along the direction and tick 3 snaps 1.6 blocks, then the arm resets.

files.label: Phase.java
files.explanation: The module file carries all six modes plus the three collision handlers: onBlockBB's inverted-box rewrite, onUpdate's noClip and ground claim, and onPushOut's cancel. The modeValue ListValue switch in onUpdate dispatches the packet sequences, and the onPacket handler is where the AAC3.5.0 sub-pixel C03 perturbation lives.

files.label: BlockUtils.kt (collide detection)
files.explanation: collideBlockIntersects is the inside-block test both onUpdate and onBlockBB rely on, ray-tracing the player's bounding box against non-air blocks, and getBlock feeds the Clip mode's air scan. The module's entire decision to phase hinges on these two predicates, making the utility the supporting half of the mechanism.

countering.label: Passable (swept-box transit)
countering.explanation: Passable ray-traces a swept box from the previous to the claimed position with axis-order retries and setIgnoreInitiallyColliding(true), so a player resting inside a block is tolerated but the transit into it is flagged. The Vanilla and Spartan 0.5-block diagonal C04s cross solid geometry outright, and Skip's 0.3-block offsets do the same, so the check fires on the teleport payload itself rather than the resting state.

countering.label: SurvivalFly (movement envelope)
countering.explanation: SurvivalFly measures each C03 against a physics envelope where ground is ray-traced, never read from the packet flag, so the all-onGround-true teleport sequence buys nothing. The (0.5, 0, 0.5) and (0.5, 0.2, 0.5) jumps are instant lateral and vertical deltas far beyond the allowed momentum envelope, producing yDistance and hDistance violations with set-back on the first packet of a sequence.

countering.label: MorePackets (movement rate)
countering.explanation: Vanilla, Spartan and Skip each burst six C04 packets in one tick on top of the normal move, tripling the per-tick rate; sustained wall-hugging sustains 60+ serverbound packets per second against the 22/s window, and the half-second burst path (15 packets, direct-violation at 10) fires on the very first sequence. Clip and AAC3.5.0 send nothing, so they are invisible to the rate layer.

countering.label: Phase (swept-AABB vs collisions)
countering.explanation: Hawk's Phase check runs a tesseract swept-AABB against the world's solid collision boxes and punishes with a rubberband on penetration. The distance guard (distanceSquared > 65) skips the large jumps, so the 1.6-block Mineplex snap and any 8+ block teleport escape it, but the small Vanilla, Skip and Spartan offsets are inside the guard and flag on the geometry crossing.
